provenance.correction_scope: Co-author names Moffat Nyirenda and Beverley Shields only; no stated statistical correction.
provenance.supplement_version_label: Publisher DC2 path dated 2021-06-08; inspected visually; no claim of byte-equivalence to DC1.

selection_rules.not_a_turkana_target_filter: The target does not expose the same health/selection flags. These are source-context requirements, not executable target exclusions.

target_transfer.note: Turkana CardioChek Plus venous-EDTA protocol and unknown fasting status are not certified equivalent; unit conversion alone does not remove these differences.

non_hdl_cholesterol.aggregation_note: Compute non-HDL row by row before its geometric mean; geometric_mean(TC - HDL) is not geometric_mean(TC) - geometric_mean(HDL). Nonpositive derived values violate the positive-domain operator and must not be silently clipped.

geometric_mean_positive.implementation_note: Candidate for separate geometric utility; existing core modules are unchanged. A formula is not proof that a source-context dataset has been reconstructed.

threshold_percentage.formula: 100 * count(x < threshold) / count(all eligible rows in declared subgroup)
threshold_percentage.denominator: all eligible records in the declared subgroup, not the subset satisfying the event

reported_age_quantile.reason: Median and quartile meanings are reported, but the finite-sample convention is not; do not silently adopt linear interpolation.

issues.details: Table 1 and Table 2 subgroup counts differ: Uganda men 2177 vs 2179; Uganda women 2424 vs 2429; Malawi rural women 5894 vs 5893; Malawi urban women 7192 vs 7190. EXTEND women also differs 4641 vs 4183 outside this candidate. Table 1 subgroup n does not prove each variable-specific n.
issues.resolution: Preserve table-specific counts and scope; do not harmonize, infer missingness causes or inverse-variance weights.

issues.details: Table 2 reports HDL geometric mean 1.15 with 95% CI 1.15 to 1.26; printed values retained.
issues.resolution: Point estimate remains a candidate; interval not used for weighting, SD conversion or an acceptance band.

issues.details: Several printed CI endpoints coincide after rounding.
issues.resolution: No zero-variance interpretation, CI-width-derived SD, exact equality tolerance or precision weight is authorized.
Age median/Q1/Q3 retained as reported distributional context, not executable calibration.
All Table 3 coefficients stay outside numerical candidates; no raw/log conversion, orientation reversal or insertion into a joint generator.
Do not drop smoking/alcohol to imitate the reported adjusted operators.
Equal-weight mathematical recipes are explicit operational choices, not a claim of verified source weighting.
External source strata are not interchangeable with Turkana lifestyle categories. Source health exclusions and assays cannot be recreated from target fields by assertion.

optional_model_assumption_note.family_example: lognormal HDL within a declared source subgroup
optional_model_assumption_note.mathematical_relation: If log(H) ~ Normal(mu,sigma^2), G=exp(mu) and p=P(H<c), then mu=log(G) and sigma=(log(c)-log(G))/Phi_inverse(p), where defined and positive.
restrictions: No inversion or parameter values computed in this packet.
Rounded constraints can be incompatible or weakly informative.
No SD is inferred from a confidence interval.
The resulting sigma would be a model-specific marginal log-scale dispersion, not an observed SD or a conditional residual SD.
The family, joint dependence and source-to-target transport would remain assumptions.

required_before_activation: Independent review of extraction and operator definitions.
Explicit source-context construction or separately approved source-to-target proxy designation.
Explicit weighting/measurement assumptions when not source-verified.
Working operator utility with its required checks; no silent fallback to existing unsupported collector.
application_rules.source_context_n_vs_generated_n: Reported source n records evidence provenance only; it neither sets synthetic row count nor makes synthetic rows new independent observations.

independent_transcription_review.meaning: Reported values checked; no source-context, transfer or runtime approval implied
